svg.title: Every struct is a TryFrom<&[u8]>
svg.desc: The 20 bytes of the IPv4 header of the book's SYN go through Ipv4Packet::try_from: a validation of the length, then of each field in wire order, then of the fields together. It returns an Ipv4Packet or a typed Ipv4Error.
